constructor: build(Parameters()) -> dict; Parameters defaults are physically used actual1 inputs
basis_order: charged (ell,m) increasing ell then m; spin up/down; neutral (ell,m) increasing ell then m, neutral fastest

units.k: 3-vector reciprocal center-lattice momentum, radians per spacing

state_semantics: One mobile charged molecule with co-moving neutral internal quantum rotor; empty-charge vacuum reference 0. No stationary per-cell rotor bath and no occupied-hole source.

operators.spectrum(model,k): full orthonormal dense Hermitian eigenvalues/vectors; never assume a degenerate vector frame is a polarized preparation
operators.vertex(model,kout,kin,epsilon): complex 162x162 center charge-current absorption vertex; momentum transfer kout-kin, outgoing emission uses epsilon_out conjugated and negative transfer
operators.contact(model,kout,kin,qin,epsin,qout,ep: complex 162x162 mixed second derivative, requires physical net kout-kin=qin-qout; epsout conjugation happens inside function
operators.charged_green(model,k,omega,eta=.01): complex 18x18 empty-vacuum charged angular/spin addition G, neutral ell0 source; eta strictly retarded regulator, not derived lifetime
operators.scattering(model,kin,qin,epsin,qout,epso: dict containing complex amplitude and contact/absorption/emission, actual recoil/outgoing energy, kout; full virtual spectrum unless explicitly supplied diagnostic subset

model_arrays.T: three 162x162 primitive spin-independent full-angular contact tunnel matrices

receiver: Actual1 final low doublet at actual nonforward kout; higher states remain internal virtual receivers. Low-doublet receive selection is an explicit observable, never a four-state coarse delivered law.
field_boundary: External A sources at macrocell links. No intra-shell minimal EM coupling, dynamical photons, D tensor or propagator normalization. The scattering amplitude is a finite-frequency source kernel, not a photon cross-section.
joining_rule: Use this entire law/state/source/current together. A field extension must place NEW dynamical degrees of freedom and every gauged link into a common Hamiltonian; do not multiply by another root's D and call it an actual join.
peer_relation: InducedSpinMedium's finite Gauss triangle root differs in law, state and geometry. Its flux response is not directly joinable. A useful next shared construction would transport THIS contact-current carrier through a NEW Gauss link field with the SAME full angular/orientor state.
